_note: 學習路徑內容第21批 #6／6：比較級 + and + 比較級 more and more（eng.t_adv.adjadv.more-and-more，學測級／高階）。『比較級 + and + 比較級』表示持續增加/漸變（越來越…）；短形容詞重複 -er（hotter and hotter）；長形容詞與 -ly 副詞用 more and more + 原級（more and more expensive / more and more slowly）；good/well 的比較級是不規則 better。誘答鎖『長形容詞硬加 -er／短形容詞用 more and more／一邊原級一邊比較級／誤用 more good 取代 better／誤解語意』等唯一正解。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix mam_）。

units.title_zh: 比較級 ＋ and ＋ 比較級（越來越…）
units.can_do: 我能用『比較級 + and + 比較級』表達越來越…：短形容詞和短副詞重複 -er（bigger and bigger、faster and faster），長形容詞和 -ly 副詞用 more and more（more and more popular），不規則比較級用 better（better and better）。
units.situation_group: 形容詞與副詞：漸進比較
units.subject: eng

claims.text: The pattern 'comparative + and + comparative' means something keeps increasing or changing continuously: 'It's getting colder and colder.'
claims.verification_ref: 比較級 + and + 比較級表持續增加/漸變（It's getting colder and colder）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: For short (one-syllable) adjectives, repeat the -er comparative: 'bigger and bigger', 'hotter and hotter'.
claims.verification_ref: 短（單音節）形容詞重複 -er 比較級（bigger and bigger / hotter and hotter）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: For longer adjectives and -ly adverbs, use 'more and more + adjective/adverb': 'more and more expensive', 'more and more slowly'.
claims.verification_ref: 長形容詞與 -ly 副詞用 more and more + 原級（more and more expensive / more and more slowly）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: This pattern describes a gradual, continuing change over time, equal to Chinese 越來越…: 'The city is becoming more and more crowded.' The comparative of good/well is the irregular 'better'.
claims.verification_ref: 此句型表隨時間漸進的持續改變（越來越…）；good/well 的比較級為不規則 better（better and better）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: 'comparative + and + comparative' means something keeps changing in one direction — getting more and more, or less and less. For short adjectives, repeat the -er form. The days are getting longer and longer.
teach.zh_hint: 『比較級 + and + 比較級』表示某事物朝同一個方向持續改變（越來越…，或越來越不…）。短形容詞重複 -er 形式。例：The days are getting longer and longer.（白天變得越來越長。）

teach.body: The days are getting longer and longer.
teach.zh_hint: 白天變得越來越長。短形容詞 long 用 longer and longer。

teach.body: For longer adjectives, use 'more and more + adjective'. Smartphones are becoming more and more popular.
teach.zh_hint: 長形容詞用 more and more + 原級。例：Smartphones are becoming more and more popular.（智慧型手機變得越來越受歡迎。）

teach.body: Smartphones are becoming more and more popular.
teach.zh_hint: 智慧型手機變得越來越受歡迎。長形容詞 popular 用 more and more popular。

teach.body: Adverbs work the same way: short ones repeat -er, and -ly adverbs use 'more and more'. The train moved faster and faster.
teach.zh_hint: 副詞同理：短的重複 -er，-ly 副詞用 more and more。例：The train moved faster and faster.（火車開得越來越快。）

teach.body: The train moved faster and faster.
teach.zh_hint: 火車開得越來越快。副詞 fast 用 faster and faster。

teach.body: She spoke more and more slowly.
teach.zh_hint: 她講得越來越慢。-ly 副詞 slowly 用 more and more slowly（不加 -er）。

teach.body: A few words are irregular. The comparative of good and well is better, so we say 'better and better', not 'more and more good'.
teach.zh_hint: 少數字是不規則的。good 和 well 的比較級是 better，所以說 better and better，不是 more and more good。

teach.body: My English is getting better and better.
teach.zh_hint: 我的英文變得越來越好。good/well 的比較級是不規則的 better。

practice.stem: 選正確：As summer comes, the weather gets ____.（夏天來了，天氣越來越熱）

distractor_rationales.more and more hot: hot 是短（單音節）形容詞，要重複 -er 形式 hotter and hotter，不用 more and more。
distractor_rationales.hot and hot: 要用比較級形式 hotter，不是原級 hot 的重複。
distractor_rationales.hotter and hot: 兩邊都要用比較級：hotter and hotter，不能一邊比較級一邊原級。

practice.feedback: hotter and hotter：短形容詞重複 -er 比較級，表越來越…。

practice.stem: 選正確：Tickets are becoming ____ every year.（票價每年變得越來越貴）

distractor_rationales.expensiver and expensiver: 長形容詞 expensive 沒有 -er 形式，要用 more and more expensive。
distractor_rationales.more expensive and expensive: 長形容詞用 more and more + 原級（more and more expensive），不是把 more expensive 和 expensive 混用。
distractor_rationales.expensive and more expensive: 格式不對，應為 more and more expensive。

practice.feedback: more and more expensive：長形容詞用 more and more + 原級。

practice.stem: 選正確：She practiced every day and played the violin ____.（她每天練習，小提琴拉得越來越好）

distractor_rationales.more and more good: good/well 的比較級是不規則的 better，不是 more good。
distractor_rationales.gooder and gooder: good 沒有 -er 形式，比較級是不規則的 better。
distractor_rationales.good and good: 要用比較級 better，不是原級 good 的重複。

practice.feedback: better and better：good/well 的比較級是不規則的 better。

practice.stem: 選出正確的句子：（排隊的人龍越來越長）
practice.answer: The line got longer and longer.
options: The line got longer and longer.
The line got long and longer.
The line got more long and long.
The line got longer and long.

兩邊都要用比較級：longer and longer，不能一邊原級。
long 是短形容詞，用 longer（不用 more long），且兩邊都要比較級。
第二個也要用比較級 longer：longer and longer。

practice.feedback: longer and longer：短形容詞重複 -er 比較級。

practice.stem: What does 'The noise grew louder and louder.' mean?

louder and louder means a gradual, continuing change, not a sudden one.
louder means more loud, the opposite of quieter.
the more-and-more pattern shows continuing change, not staying the same.

practice.feedback: louder and louder = gradually, continuously louder, so the noise kept getting noisier.

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: The city is becoming more and more crowded.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：is becoming、more and more crowded（長形容詞用 more and more）、句尾句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。兩個比較級都清楚讀出、句尾下收。

lines.text: I am getting better and better at English.
lines.intonation: better and better 清楚、句尾 English 下收

lines.text: The music grew louder and louder.
lines.intonation: louder and louder 清楚、句尾下收
